title: Facile fabrication of a novel chitosan/carboxymethyl cellulose/bentonite/CuO nanocomposite for enhanced photocatalytic and antibacterial applications
content:

The green synthesized hybrid nanocomposite CS/CMC/BN/CuO NC exhibited remarkable photocatalytic efficiency and outstanding antibacterial properties. Hence, this hybrid nanocomposite holds significant potential for wastewater treatment applications.
